summary: Official municipal cadastral responsibility and procedure were verified, and SUNARP's official registered-plot viewer was identified. Anonymous bounded requests yielded only an IDEP map-sheet layer or an access/timeout outcome; no safe parcel identity and geometry were retrieved, so no GeoJSON sample is retained and runtime remains held.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and Spanish first-party discovery queries and actual result URLs are recorded in city-3592-tacna.json.
requestOutcomes: IDEP layer metadata and a bounded attribute query returned HTTP 200 for a non-parcel polygon map-sheet layer in EPSG:4326. The SUNARP BGR host timed out anonymously and its official procedure requires DNI, issue date, and CAPTCHA. Municipal official PDF/procedure evidence established the cadastral custodian but exposed no anonymous parcel API.
